product_name: egg beaters ORIGINAL LIQUID EGG SUBSTITUTE, egg beaters CAGE-FREE ORIGINAL LIQUID EGG SUBSTITUTE, egg beaters CAGE-FREE ORIGINAL FROZEN EGG SUBSTITUTE, Bob Evans Better’n Eggs Made with Real Egg Whites
summary: Cargill Kitchen Solutions is recalling liquid egg products such as "egg beaters ORIGINAL LIQUID EGG SUBSTITUTE" and "Bob Evans Better’n Eggs Made with Real Egg Whites" due to potential contamination with an unapproved cleaning solution, posing a marginal risk. Consumers are advised not to consume the recalled items and should discard or return them to the point of sale.
hazard_type: unapproved cleaning solution with sodium hypochlorite
consumer_action: Consumers who purchased these products are urged not to consume them and food service establishments not to serve them. These products should be discarded or returned to the point of sale.
